It is the rate across applications we prepare and submit. It is high partly because we audit files before submission and decline to submit ones that are not ready.

It is not a prediction about your case. The consulate decides that, and no agency can change it.

slides.headline: OUR APPROVAL RATE IS 94.7%.
slides.sub: Here is what that number actually is.
slides.note: Every agency quotes a figure. Very few explain how it is produced. Ours is worth explaining.

slides.answer: IT IS NOT A PREDICTION ABOUT YOU.
slides.body: It is the rate across applications we prepare and submit. Your case is decided by the consulate, on its own merits.
slides.note: Anyone presenting a success rate as a personal guarantee is misleading you.

slides.headline: THE NUMBER IS HIGH
items: We audit every file before submission
We fix the weaknesses we find rather than submitting around them
We decline to submit files that are not ready
We match applications to the right consulate

slides.headline: HOW SUCCESS RATES GET MISUSED
slides.never: Treat a published rate as a promise about your own application. A rate describes a population, not a person, and no agency controls a consulate's decision.
slides.instead: Ask what the agency actually controls — file quality, consulate selection, document consistency — and judge them on that. That is the honest measure.

slides.headline: 5K+ VISAS ISSUED · 25K+ CONSULTATIONS
slides.body: A licensed Dubai documentation agency. We are not an embassy, a consulate, VFS or BLS. Approval, processing time, entries and validity are decided solely by the relevant consulate.
slides.takeaway: You can also apply directly, without paid assistance.
